archimate:Capability.name: 7.0 Knowledge Dissemination and Alerts
archimate:Capability.documentation:
Governs the structured creation, targeted routing, and multi-channel transmission of validated public health insights, clinical guidelines, situation reports, and emergency alerts to specific stakeholder groups
Example: A health system utilizes this capability by automatically pushing an urgent notification and a revised prescribing guide to all practicing pediatricians the moment a major regulatory agency issues a new warning about a common childhood cough medicine.
